hero.taglineBadge: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment | PM-AJAY (GIA Component)
hero.mainHeading: Find the Right Skills. Build the Right Future.
hero.subHeading: Multilingual, voice-first AI career mapping platform empowering Scheduled Caste (SC) beneficiaries with NSQF-aligned job skilling, transparent matching, and wage progression pathways.
hero.listenPrompt: Click the mic or speak naturally in Hindi or English
hero.step1Desc: Interact using your voice or simple text in your preferred language.
hero.step2Desc: Conversational assessment extracts education, skills, interests & location.
hero.step3Desc: Profiles are benchmarked against official National Skills Qualification Frameworks.
hero.step4Desc: Receive transparent match scores, identified skill gaps & subsidized training paths.
hero.step5Desc: 100% government-subsidized course enrollment with tool-kit assistance.
hero.testMicText: Click mic to test voice response
hero.sampleSpeech: Namaste! I am your AI career assistant. Tap the mic to discover your vocational pathway.
hero.freeGovtSkillingDesc: Full course fees, learning materials, and NSDC certification are fully funded under PM-AJAY GIA.
hero.toolkitSupportDesc: Certified candidates receive government financial support for toolkits and enterprise setup.
hero.placementSupportDesc: Direct connections to authorized employers, apprentice programs, and district enterprise clusters.
